Joining our new business team, you will leverage your strong network to trigger new business opportunities and win sales, pitching our unique and innovative set of customer-first solutions designed for grocery retailers: customer loyalty, customer engagement, category management, price and promotions, data and media monetization. You will manage the new business cycle through prospecting, qualification, needs analysis, stakeholder mapping, pitching and negotiation. Once contracts are won, you will roll out the optimum operating model to get client engagement up and running to execute plans. You will work with a range of stakeholders, Products specialists, finance and legal, as well as senior members within client organizations.

What we expect from you:

  • Successful track record, 5+ years, of delivering new business targets in a tech / consulting environment
  • A strong network of senior contacts within grocery retailers and CPG's (plus)
  • Building great relationships with new client stakeholders, establishing trust and becoming a true partner
  • Consultative approach to selling, identifying needs and selling customer-first solutions
  • Great collaboration with colleagues


What You Can Expect From Us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found (here)

title: Analista Administrativo
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?


Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.


Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.


No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².


Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.


No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.


A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso Analista Administrativo, você irá:


  • Preparar e revisar apresentações, relatórios e materiais de reunião (PowerPoint, Excel, Word);
  • Apoiar a equipeem tarefas administrativas e de coordenação, garantindo o bom funcionamento das operações diárias;
  • Auxiliar no agendamento, preparação de reuniões e organização de documentos;
  • Dar suporte em tarefas básicas de contabilidade, controle de despesas e emissão de faturas;
  • Colaborar de perto com a alta gestão para assegurar a entrega pontual das demandas.



Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:


  • Superior Completo em Administração, Contabilidade e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio do pacote Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word);
  • Conhecimentos básicos em processos de contabilidade e faturamento;
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais e de comunicação.
  • Perfil proativo, detalhista e confortável em atuar em um ambiente internacional dinâmico;
  • Inglês avançado.


Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:


  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Refeição
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

description:
Job Title: IT Support Engineer (Short-Term Project)


Project Duration:

This is a 2-day onsite job activity


Scope of Work:

The selected Engineer/Consultant/Technician will be responsible for the deployment and installation of Microsoft IoT sensors at the client site. The scope of work includes:


1. Provide an efficient workforce for the project.

2. Technician/Consultant/Engineer must wear PPE, including safety glasses, safety shoes, helmet, and earplugs, if required at the site. These will be provided by the End-Customer.

3. Follow local health and safety codes, adhering to any guidelines provided at the site.

5. Complete local safety training or other mandatory requirements before starting work. 6. Bring the necessary tools to complete tasks.

7. Perform all work in the presence of the Client’s stakeholders.

8. Review the site readiness for deployment, including checking rack and cabling availability.

9. With local supervisor approval, take photographs of the rack and network setup before and after work, ensuring no unrelated areas are captured.

10.Unpack and review the technical specifications of the IoT sensor (form factor, power requirements) before installation.

11.Remove the existing nozomi sensor (server), disconnect all cables, and hand it over to the Client’s team.

12.Tag and label all installed hardware, power supplies, and wiring as instructed, using provided tags and labels.

13.Install new hardware for Microsoft IoT sensors, including rack mounting and connecting cables (power, network, earthing).

14.Record the MAC address and serial number of the new IoT sensor.

15.Verify all network configurations and network traffic. Confidential-Third Party 16.Complete and submit the asset information form, including details such as MAC address, serial number, model, and default credentials for all hardware.

17.Configure management IP to enable remote connectivity for Wipro’s team.

18.Participate in interface meetings with the Wipro/Kenvue team.


Who Can Apply:

  • IT Support Engineers / Technicians / Consultants with hands-on experience in hardware installation, networking, and onsite client coordination.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.E., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.E., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

title: Client Services Coordinator
description:
Client Services Coordinator


Role Overview: A Leadership Role in Strategic Talent Acquisition

The Client Services Coordinator is a pivotal, client-facing leadership role that sits at the intersection of client management, operational excellence, and strategic talent acquisition. You will be the primary operational and strategic partner for a dedicated portfolio of clients utilizing our Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO ).


This position is about driving performance: ensuring compliance, leading a team of recruiters, optimizing the full recruitment lifecycle, and managing the financial health of your client accounts. You will be instrumental in building long-term client trust while delivering measurable results and introducing innovative recruitment strategies.


Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities fall into three core areas: Client & Strategy Management , Team & Process


Leadership , and Operational & Financial Control .

1. Client & Strategy Management

  • Strategic Partnership: Serve as the primary point of contact and strategic partner, cultivating deep, long-term trust with clients, hiring managers, and internal recruiters.
  • Solution Delivery: Develop and execute strategies for RPO and MSP solutions, proactively anticipating client needs and introducing new and innovative recruitment and selection concepts.
  • Stakeholder Satisfaction: Increase satisfaction for both internal clients (Hiring Managers) and candidates by designing and overseeing structured selection processes with consistent communication and feedback.
  • Transparent Reporting: Ensure a positive, transparent relationship through regular weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews to present results, propose new strategies, and discuss performance.


2. Team & Process Leadership

  • Full-Cycle Management: Own and manage the entire recruitment process for a portfolio of accounts, often focused on filling niche, challenging, and specialized positions.
  • Recruiter Leadership: Directly lead, manage, and develop a team of recruiters and researchers, providing constant feedback and structured development plans.
  • Process Improvement: Drive continuous improvement in selection execution by evaluating and integrating new recruitment technologies and tools.
  • Recruiter Support: Provide proactive, hands-on support to the team in candidate sourcing efforts and overcoming roadblocks.


3. Operational & Financial Control

  • Performance Monitoring: Directly manage and control Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all accounts through robust control and monitoring methodologies.
  • Data & Insights: Build and maintain operational dashboards and vacancy spreadsheets, ensuring data accuracy and facilitating clear communication across all stakeholders.
  • Financial Health: Ensure the financial performance of the client contract portfolio by managing Gross Profit (GP) and Operating Expenses (Opex) .


Candidate Requirements


Experience & Education

  • Minimum Experience: A minimum of 5 years of professional experience is required.
  • Leadership/Specialist Experience: Proven experience in a leadership, senior specialist, or similar high-level role is highly valued.
  • Preferred Industry Background: Experience in a multinational company is preferred. Experience in Pharmaceutical, Medical Devices, or Life Sciences is a plus but not mandatory.
  • Education: Completed Higher Education (University Degree) is mandatory.


Skills & Technical Expertise

1. Core Capabilities (Dominant/Expert Knowledge Required)

  • Recruitment & Selection (R&S): Expert-level, hands-on knowledge of full-cycle recruiting processes, strategies, and best practices.
  • Data & Metrics Management: Strong experience in building and utilizing operational dashboards and key recruitment metrics (KPIs/SLAs) for control, monitoring, and strategic decision-making.
  • Computer Skills (Office Suite): Expert-level proficiency in Excel (for data analysis and reporting), PowerPoint (for strategic presentations), Word , and Outlook .

2. Strategic & Leadership Skills (Strong Proficiency Required)

  • Operational & Process Leadership: Proven ability to lead and develop people, manage complex demand cycles, and drive overall process efficiency.
  • Client Management: Strong skill set in managing relationships, fostering long-term trust, and presenting business reviews and proposals to key stakeholders.


Location, Compensation, & Language


Compensation

  • Salary Range: R9,5000–R11,000 (Gross Monthly Salary).
  • Note: This figure is dependent on experience and is subject to internal benchmarking.


Location & Language Requirements

This role is based in Brazil and requires specific language proficiencies for client-facing and strategic communication:

  • Location: Must reside in or near São Paulo, Brazil .
  • Portuguese: Required (Proficient or Native fluency).
  • English: Required (Advanced or Business Fluency for strategic client and internal communication).
  • Spanish: Basic proficiency is considered a distinct advantage.

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.


Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation


For more information, you may check our website：


Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.


Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)


Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.


Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

O Gerente Sr. de Relações Sindicais desempenha um papel crucial na definição e execução da estratégia de relações sindicais da PepsiCo do Brasil Foods. Esse cargo é responsável por desenvolver uma estrutura abrangente que esteja alinhada aos objetivos operacionais e à força de trabalho da PepsiCo do Brasil Foods, garantindo uma abordagem proativa e estratégica em relações sindicais. Atuando como principal negociador em negociações coletivas e interações com Conselhos de Trabalho, Sindicatos e representantes dos empregados, o Diretor de Relações Trabalhistas representa os interesses da PBF enquanto promove relações produtivas e positivas.


Sindicatos e empregados sindicalizados:Gerenciar relações com aprox. 80 sindicatos e conduzir mais de 330 negociações, representando 100% dos empregados sindicalizados, de forma a gerenciar eficazmente os processos de negociação coletiva. Melhorar as relações com o Ministério do Trabalho e outras autoridades.


Seu impacto


Negociação com sindicatos de Vendedores, Comércio, Motoristas e Operações (~150/ano);

Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais relacionados a todas as negociações coletivas;

Relacionamento com o Ministério do Trabalho e com os principais líderes sindicais, a fim de garantir negociações coletivas eficazes.


Quem estamos buscando?


  • Ensino Superior completa em Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida vivência com relações sindicais e negociações.
  • Inglês/espanhol - diferencial
  • Excelente habilidade analítica e organizacional, incluindo definição de prioridades e tomada de decisões;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de iniciativa e de priorizar a carga de trabalho, sendo capaz de entregar resultados sob pressão e dentro de prazos definidos;
  • Trabalho em equipe, com habilidade para liderar e influenciar.


Se esta oportunidade for do seu interesse, incentivamos que se candidate, mesmo que não atenda 100% dos requisitos.


O que você pode esperar da gente?


Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção;
    ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.


Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. description:

Position Overview:

The ideal candidate will be fluent in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, highly skilled in customer engagement, and comfortable translating complex technology into clear business value.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Automate recurring tasks in container-based workflows into reusable CI/CD assets.
  • Design, build, manage and operate the infrastructure and configuration of container platforms with a focus on automation and infrastructure-as-cod
  • Manage Hybrid cloud enterprise Kubernetes clusters
  • Ensure reliable WFH readiness with stable high-bandwidth internet.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s/master’s in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud, DevOps, or technical sales engineering in LATAM.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux platforms .
  • Hands-on with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle Cloud).
  • Expertise in Kubernetes, container platforms, and hybrid cloud operations .
  • Proficiency in automation tools (Ansible, Helm, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Strong scripting background (Bash, Korn shell, PowerShell).
  • Exceptional communication and client-facing experience .
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-changing environment.
  • Availability for regional travel.

Matilda Cloud offers a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits, and a vibrant, supportive work culture. We are dedicated to innovation and quality, providing our team with opportunities for professional growth and meaningful contributions to the cloud computing field.


Apply Now:

If you are passionate about leveraging your cloud technology expertise to drive engagements within the LATAM market and are fluent in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, we invite you to apply. Join Matilda Cloud to be at the forefront of delivering transformative cloud solutions across LATAM.

title: Líder Técnico De Digital Assets – Kaleido Brasil
description:
A função

A Kaleido está em busca de um Líder Técnico de Digital Assets – Kaleido Brasil para nos representar como a face técnica do nosso negócio no país. Nesta posição sênior, você será responsável por conduzir ciclos complexos de pré-vendas, fortalecer o ecossistema de parceiros, impulsionar uma comunidade técnica vibrante e supervisionar as primeiras implementações de clientes. Você garantirá que os PoCs e as entregas iniciais em Kaleido/FireFly estabeleçam o padrão em segurança, conformidade e escala.


Sobre nós

A Kaleido oferece uma plataforma de próxima geração para construção e conexão com redes descentralizadas (ex.: Ethereum, Bitcoin, Canton) em nuvem e Kubernetes. Combinamos tecnologias open source e proprietárias para fornecer middleware, gestão de ativos digitais e soluções de custódia. Nossa plataforma permite que clientes criem casos de uso corporativos integrados a ecossistemas descentralizados e ativos digitais — seja em nosso SaaS ou em nuvens privadas.


Responsabilidades

Arquitetura de Soluções em Pré-Vendas

  • Conduzir workshops de discovery, delimitar escopos de soluções, realizar demonstrações, desenvolver PoCs e analisar RFPs;
    produzir propostas técnicas, estimativas e arquiteturas prontas para SOW.
  • Mapear requisitos regulatórios e de conformidade no Brasil (ex.: CVM 175, LGPD, controles do setor financeiro) para desenhos técnicos, boas práticas de segurança e runbooks.
  • Mitigar riscos em negociações com arquiteturas de referência, planos de migração e critérios de sucesso;
    acelerar a transição dePoC para produção.

Ecossistema de Parceiros e Alianças

  • Identificar, recrutar, integrar e capacitar parceiros.

Arquitetura e Acompanhamento das Primeiras Entregas

Feedback de Produto

  • Canalizar insights de mercado e parceiros para o roadmap global, defendendo padrões específicos do Brasil.


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação/Engenharia (ou experiência equivalente).

    3+ anos em pré-vendas/soluções com clientes;
    3+ anos em blockchain corporativo.
  • Experiência prática com EVM (Solidity, upgradeability, Hardhat/Foundry) e Kaleido/FireFly (ou frameworks similares de private-tx/data-exchange).

    familiaridade com fluxos de liquidação (PIX/SPI/STR, DvP).
  • Cloud & DevOps: Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform), AWS e/ou Azure.

    espanhol é um diferencial.


Qualificações desejáveis

Diversidade e Inclusão

A Kaleido é comprometida em promover um ambiente inclusivo que celebre a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Valorizamos indivíduos de diferentes origens, culturas e experiências, e buscamos criar um espaço onde todos se sintam bem-vindos e apoiados. A Kaleido é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas qualificadas de todos os perfis a se candidatarem.

title: Financial Controller - Latam
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.
Job Description
Your Career
Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a LatAm Controller to join our Finance Team. We are looking for a financial professional interested in a senior level opportunity as a regional Controller to ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting and financial reporting for the Palo Alto Networks legal entities in the Latin American region and play a key role in re-engineering processes to drive improvement. This position has extensive interaction with cross-functional business partners at all levels, including senior management in multiple geographical locations.
A successful candidate will be proactive, confident and solution-oriented, have a broad set of work experiences within a Finance organization, and will provide a strong voice to represent Finance throughout the Controllership to arrive at solutions all cross-functional groups will find reasonable.
Your Impact
  • Identify actionable insights and drive cross-functional process improvements including, but not limited to, internal and external financial reporting, regulatory compliance, internal controls and system integration in the region
  • Lead the formulation of the Country Controlling strategy for the region to align with business needs and corporate strategy
  • Take ownership of facilitation and creation of accurate project plans with clearly defined milestones, deliverables and tasks
  • Perform monthly detailed reviews of the regional financial statements to ensure alignment with corporate reporting and local accounting GAAP reporting requirements
  • Perform month-end close for the regional entities to ensure accurate US GAAP and company policy compliant financial statements, including reviewing monthly transactions, account reconciliations, and balance sheet and income statements for reasonableness
  • Effectively provide guidance and support to GL resources in the Palo Alto Networks Center of Excellence to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of the regional month-end close process
  • Coordinate with IT, global and regional accounting functions, and regional third-party accounting service providers on regional system implementation projects
  • Establish effective partnerships with Palo Alto Networks Global Process Owners, Centers of Excellence and corporate and regional accounting teams to drive the incorporation of global process standards in the region
  • Establish and document all policies, process and procedures localization requirements for the region
  • Effectively manage third-party service providers in region to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of their services
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits for various entities in region
  • Review and approve non-routine transactions in the regional entities
  • Ensure controls and discipline are in place to achieve high employee satisfaction within the region
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives in region
  • Ensure local compliance with regional regulations, regulatory filings, and accounting rules (GAAP)
  • Effectively partner with regional and corporate FP&A and People teams to provide accounting insight and support on regional matters
  • Work with cross-functional teams on treasury and tax strategies to support compliance and the corporate goals for the region
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • At least 8-12 years of relevant experience in a medium to large size international reporting environment is required and working experience in high tech companies with prior Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in accounting or finance – Contador or equivalent certification a plus
  • In-depth expertise, excellent working ability, and knowledge of local GAAP accounting principles, regulatory compliance and reporting requirements
  • Hands-on experience managing the accounting and financial reporting processes for international operations in the Latin American region
  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems
  • Proficient in US accounting standards, principles and pronouncements
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments, meet challenging deadlines and priorities, deliver on multiple simultaneous projects and drive changes
  • Problem solver with strong critical thinking and project management skills
  • Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing work, identifying issues and recommending solutions, and managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Fluent in English, fluent in Spanish or Portuguese a plus
  • Highly collaborative with a leadership attitude to take initiative to solve problems
  • Highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively, including cross-functionally
Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role.
 Additional Information
The Team
You have a passion for numbers & integration, our organization has a passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Our accounting department deals with numbers daily, supporting infrastructure, dealing in automation, building solutions and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our business lines. The ideal candidate has exceptional skills in accounting and analytics and an innovative mindset to approach finance problems differently. Our innovation doesn’t stay in Research and Development. Within finance and accounting, we seek people who are looking to try new things, while solving business critical equations. If you’re seeking a financial challenge but with a world-wide impact – this is it.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Java Stack)
description:
We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused On-Site Technical Support Engineer to provide technical expertise for our financial services products, with a focus on credit industry solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong Java development skills, hands-on experience with MySQL, and a proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in real-time. A background in the credit/banking industry and exceptional client communication skills are essential to succeed in this role.


Key Responsibilities


Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Provide on-site and remote technical support for the financial systems, ensuring minimal downtime and rapid resolution of issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve problems related to Java applications, Redis caching, MySQL databases, and associated middleware.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and implement preventive measures.


System Maintenance & Optimization

  • Monitor system performance, conduct regular health checks, and optimize configurations for Redis, MySQL, and Java applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to deploy patches, updates, and hotfixes in production environments.


Client Communication & Requirements Handling

  • Act as the primary technical liaison between clients and the Chinese teams, transmitting business needs to technical solution arthitect in China.
  • Respond promptly to client operational requests, prioritize tasks, and manage expectations effectively.


Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Create detailed technical documentation, including incident reports, troubleshooting guides, and best practices.
  • Train clients on system functionalities and operational workflows.


Compliance & Collaboration

  • Ensure solutions adhere to local credit industry regulations (e.G., data security, audit requirements).
  • Work closely with DevOps, QA, and product teams to improve system reliability and user experience.


Requirements


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Java development and debugging (Spring Boot, J2EE, or similar frameworks).
  • Strong experience with MySQL (query optimization, replication, backup/recovery).
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Linux/Unix environments, and scripting (Shell/Python).
  • Knowledge of DevOps tools (Jenkins, Docker) and monitoring systems (Prometheus, Grafana) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Redis (cluster management, performance tuning) is a plus.


Industry Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support or development roles, preferably within the credit, banking, or fintech sectors .
  • Understanding of credit business processes (e.G., loan management, risk assessment, payment systems).


Soft Skills

  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel frequently for on-site client support.


Language

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications in Java, Redis, MySQL, or cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).
  • Experience with microservices architecture and cloud-native technologies.
  • Knowledge of financial compliance standards (e.G., PCI-DSS, GDPR).
  • Knowledge of credit risk management systems(e.G., FICO, Neurotech).

  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for someone to join the Credix Operations team as an Customer Support Analyst. You love serving clients and providing recommendations on how we can improve efficiency and effectiveness across our organization. You understand the needs of the organization and make changes to streamline operations.


Qualifications

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, both written and verbal.
  • Passionate about the customer journey and willing to embrace a continuous improvement mindset, always seeking ways to optimize processes, improve performance, and innovate.
  • You are open to feedback and willing to experiment with new approaches.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills: you can quickly learn complex systems, break down problems, and develop rigorous and quantitative arguments to inform decision-making.
  • You are proactive and a fast learner.
  • Enthusiastic team player with a strong work ethic, entrepreneurial spirit, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset combined with outstanding interpersonal and communication skills.


Responsibilities

  • Spend 90% of your time on daily customer support operations, ensuring a seamless experience for customers by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and maintaining high service standards.
  • Act as a key user for customer support systems, ensuring smooth operation and effective use of tools and technology.
  • Represent the customer’s voice within the organization, collecting and analyzing feedback to identify recurring challenges and improvement opportunities.
  • Dedicate 10% of your time to process improvement, redesigning workflows, and implementing enhancements to improve efficiency, reduce resolution times, and scale operations.
  • Maintain and update the customer knowledge center, ensuring it reflects accurate and up-to-date information based on common inquiries and feedback.
  • Support the Product & Growth teams by structuring and sharing customer insights that inform product development and strategic initiatives.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:


  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Senior Consultant – Global Transaction Banking
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .


As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant with strong expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).


If you are passionate about corporate banking solutions , trade finance , and cash management , and want to lead impactful transformation projects in the financial industry, this opportunity is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead gap analysis, requirements gathering, and validation to define practical solutions and perform comparative assessments with a strategic focus on Global Transaction Banking (GTB) .
  • Drive and support initiatives in:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Factoring/Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Finance/Confirming, Export & Agency Finance, Structured Trade).
  • Cash Management (cash pooling, sweeping, virtual accounts, liquidity dashboards).
  • Plan, oversee, and coordinate project deliverables within defined time and cost parameters .
  • Prepare and deliver project reporting to senior management through presentations and executive updates.
  • Coordinate workshops and meetings with internal and external stakeholders for strategic alignment and requirements validation.
  • Define and execute testing initiatives in collaboration with IT teams.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination between Business, IT, Operations, Risk, and other stakeholders to meet client needs.
  • Support change management and successful adoption of new systems or processes.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Knowledge of PIX (Brazilian instant payments): rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulations (BACEN: PIX, TED, DOC) and international trade finance standards .
  • Proven experience participating in the implementation of PIX (Brazil’s instant payment system) , including setup, rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial consulting, institutional or corporate banking , or related sectors.
  • Hands-on expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) with working knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Receivables Finance).
  • Cash Management (payments, liquidity, pooling, virtual accounts).
  • Proven skills in requirements gathering, senior-level reporting, IT liaison, and testing .
  • Familiarity with corporate banking platforms such as Finastra, Temenos, Oracle Flexcube, Kyriba, or similar.
  • Experience with digital and API-based GTB solutions .
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Spanish is a strong plus.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP / Treasury Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP Treasury, Kyriba, Oracle Treasury, or Finastra.
  • Familiarity with process automation (RPA) and liquidity dashboards (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience in operational and liquidity risk management .
  • Exposure to cross-border payments, FX, and international trade finance projects .
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), workshop facilitation, and requirements discovery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CPA-20, CTP, CFA ;
    graduate degrees (Master’s or specialization) in Finance, Economics, International Business, or Risk Management.


Preferred Education

  • Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Engineering (Industrial, Systems, Production) — strong foundation in corporate finance, trade finance, and process optimization.
  • Advanced education (Master’s level or specialization) highly valued:
  • Master’s in Finance, Economics, or International Business.
  • MBA focused on strategic management and stakeholder engagement.
  • Postgraduate degrees in Banking, Treasury, or Risk Management.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead strategic GTB transformation projects for top-tier financial institutions.
  • Work in a dynamic and international environment with exposure to high-impact banking initiatives.
  • Continuous learning, certifications, and professional development plans .
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • Flexible work model (Hybrid – São Paulo).


CLT contract benefits:

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • VR - R$ 800,00
  • A collaborative work environment, internal events, and global mobility opportunities.


Learn more about us: nfq.Es | LinkedIn NFQ

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)


Ready to lead GTB transformation and make an impact in corporate banking? Apply now!

  • Conhecimento em regulamentação de medicamentos sintéticos.


Habilidades que fazem a diferença:

title: Analista De Desenvolvimento Pleno/Engenheiro De Dados
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Desenvolvimento Pleno - Engenheiro de Dados



Resumo:

Buscamos uma pessoa com um conhecimento em engenharia e análise de dados, principalmente voltada para soluções na Azure. Trabalhará com plataformas e aplicações disponíveis na Kantar e a principal responsabilidade é planejar e desenvolver soluções desde a arquitetura até a entrega (desde a arquitetura, passando pela ETL e finalizando na visualização dos dados no Power Bi), passando por todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de software.



O que você irá fazer:

  • Levantamento e Análise de Requisitos: Entender junto ao cliente quais as necessidades de negócio, propor soluções e documentar essas necessidades através de especificações funcionais;
  • Executar tarefas em todas as fases do ciclo de desenvolvimento (Análise, Design de Arquitetura, Codificação e Deploy);
  • Participar da definição de processos e ferramentas;
  • Participar na elaboração e na manutenção da documentação técnica dos sistemas desenvolvidos;
  • Sustentação dasaplicações em produção, visando garantir a estabilidade e disponibilidade destes sistemas.




O que buscamos?


Qualificações fundamentais :

  • Sólida experiência como analista ou engenheiro de dados;
  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio dos conceitos de programação (estruturas de dados, lógica de programação, algoritmos, orientação a objetos, etc);
  • Coleta e preparação dos dados (mapeamento de fontes, ETL e limpeza de dados usando Azure Databricks);
  • Análise de dados (exploração, identificação de padrões, criação de dashboards no Power BI);
  • Conhecimento emmodelagem de bancos de dados relacional e multidimensional;
  • Conhecimento em consultas a Data Warehouse Hive (HiveSQL);
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento na linguagem PySpark/Python;
  • Experiencia comPowerBI;
  • Conhecimento emAzure Devops (principalmente Repos e CI/CD);
  • Conceitos de metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento (SCRUM e/ou KANBAN).



Qualificações desejáveis:

title: Coordenador De Cobranças
description:
A inovação e o pioneirismo sempre fizeram parte da nossa história, que começou em 1980. Temos o DNA de varejo, já que nascemos da Pernambucanas – marca centenária que sempre contou com os serviços financeiros para apoiar as famílias brasileiras de maneira fácil e democrática. Ao longo dos anos, as soluções evoluíram e se diversificaram, permitindo à Pefisa se consolidar no mercado financeiro.

Somos responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e gestão de produtos como cartões, empréstimo pessoal, seguros e a conta digital, com diferenciais como simplicidade, praticidade e sem burocracia. Prezamos por bons relacionamentos, pelo atendimento próximo e por jogar junto.

Com mais de 5 milhões de clientes ativos e grande relevância na área do varejo, disponibilizamos um amplo portfólio de serviços para pessoas físicas e jurídicas, além de um Banking as a Service (BaaS) para marcas de diversos segmentos. Com isso, adotamos iniciativas inovadoras para clientes e parceiros.

Na Pefisa tudo é simples. Tudo é rápido. Te ajudamos com o que você precisa para realizar seus sonhos ou alavancar seu negócio. E você escolhe como quer conversar, pois nós somos Fígital. Atuamos com a melhor experiência entre o físico e o digital, com nossas plataformas digitais ou através de nossas lojas físicas. Somos a fintech pra gente como a gente.


Coordenador(a) de Cobrança


Estamos buscando um(a) Coordenador(a) de Cobrança experiente para fazer a gestão e aprimorar nossas estratégias de cobrança, visando a recuperação de crédito e o aumento da rentabilidade. O profissional será responsável por liderar e desenvolver uma equipe de analistas e atuar como elo principal entre a empresa e os parceiros externos.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Ser o(a) principal representante da empresa junto aos parceiros de Call Center e escritórios de cobrança (Escobs), realizando visitas e participando de comitês de resultados.
  • Garantir a precisão das regras e políticas de cobrança estabelecidas.
  • Controlar e avaliar a eficiência das políticas de cobrança, incluindo a ordem de priorização de clientes, segmentação por risco, valores e perfis.
  • Definir estratégias por canal, como telefone, e-mail, SMS, WhatsApp, cartas e autoatendimento digital.
  • Atuar como um agente de transformação de resultados, colaborando com estratégias 'champion x challenger' para o motor de decisão de cobrança.
  • Controlar e acompanhar os KPIs operacionais de Call Center e Escobs, implementando medidas corretivas quando necessário.
  • Criar campanhas de recuperação diferenciadas para clientes com atraso.
  • Ter disponibilidade para viagens, com a necessidade de visitar operações em cidades como Lins e Pederneiras, e os seis escritórios de cobrança localizados em São Paulo.


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Experiência comprovada no mercado de cobrança, com profundo conhecimento de todo o fluxo de cobrança, como a régua de cobrança e os processos de gestão em call centers e escritórios.
  • Capacidade de analisar indicadores, discutir resultados e desenvolver estratégias de forma autônoma.
  • Ser um(a) profissional com excelente relacionamento interpessoal, que consiga conduzir conversas de forma sênior e represente a empresa com ética e confiança, especialmente ao lidar com os donos dos escritórios parceiros.
  • Visão analítica de resultados e habilidade para trabalhar com números.
  • É essencial que o(a) profissional saiba segmentar a carteira e definir as melhores abordagens para cada tipo de cliente.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Parceria com instituições de Ensino para cursos de graduação, pós graduação e descontos em curso de idiomas.


Horário de trabalho: Segunda a Sexta-feira das 08:00 às 17:00.

title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager
description:
About the Team


You’ll be joining a small but mighty People team of four, spread across the U.S. and Brazil. We’re a tight-knit crew that covers Talent Acquisition, People Operations, and other key functions that keep our company running smoothly as we scale.

We move fast, take big swings, and care deeply about building a thoughtful employee experience. Everyone on the team has broad ownership, and we’re the kind of group that figures things out together, learns quickly, and keeps it real along the way. If you’re energized by a high-impact role where no two days look the same, you’ll fit right in.


What is the role?

We are seeking an experienced and strategic HR Business Partner to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, driving HR initiatives that support our company's growth, culture, and organizational effectiveness. You will play a critical role in aligning HR strategies with business objectives and ensuring our teams are empowered and engaged.


This role will be hybrid to our São Paulo office, which will require you in office 2-3 days per week.

This is a CLT contract, paid in $BRL.


In this role you'll:

  • Partner with senior leadership and management to develop and implement HR strategies that align with business goals.
  • Design and implement organizational structures that enhance efficiency and support business growth.
  • Coach and develop leaders to build strong leadership capabilities across the organization.
  • Provide expert guidance on organizational design, talent management, employee relations, and performance management.
  • Lead cross-functional projects and work in a matrix environment collaborating with global teams to drive HR initiatives.
  • Drive initiatives related to employee engagement, culture, and talent development.
  • Support leaders through change management, workforce planning, and capability development.
  • Analyze HR metrics and data to identify trends and recommend solutions.
  • Leverage AI tools and technologies to enhance HR processes and decision-making.
  • Ensure compliance with employment laws and internal policies.
  • Act as a point of contact for employee concerns and facilitate effective communication across teams.


What you'll bring:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as an HR Business Partner or in a similar strategic HR role.
  • Fluent in English (both written and spoken).
  • Strong interpersonal and influencing skills with the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels in a remote and hybrid environment.
  • Proven experience in organizational design, including org structure development, job architecture, and operating model design.
  • Strong track record in coaching and developing leaders at various levels.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools and technologies in HR processes (e.G., talent analytics, recruitment, or employee engagement).
  • Proven experience supporting a fast-paced, development-driven tech environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects and work in a matrix structure, collaborating effectively with global cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and work autonomously.
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.


Nice to have:

  • Experience working in or with American or international tech companies and also in global companies with strong interaction with headquarters.
  • Knowledge of HRIS systems and analytics tools.
  • Advanced knowledge of organizational design methodologies and frameworks.


Additional details:

At Teachable, we are committed to providing fair and competitive pay (using market data to inform our pay bands), rewarding high performance, and ensuring all employees have the opportunity and ability to impact Teachable’s overall company value. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically following performance review cycles currently conducted annually or in conjunction with a promotion.

Somos um escritório de advocacia full service, com atuação para mais de 1.300 clientes de diversos setores e de mais de 70 países, com sede em São Paulo e unidade em Miami. Acreditamos na força das empresas que inovam, transformam e lideram mercados.

Com a solidez de um escritório reconhecido pelas publicações mais prestigiadas do mundo como Chambers Brazil e Global, Legal 500, IFLR, Leaders League, entre outras, como um dos melhores do Brasil por sua excelência e abordagem pró-business, entregamos soluções ágeis, estratégicas e orientadas a resultados.

Nosso time combina profundo conhecimento jurídico com uma ampla visão de negócios, atuando lado a lado com quem constrói um Brasil mais moderno, competitivo e justo.

Fomos reconhecidos pela Great Place to Work (GPTW) e pelo GPTW Diversidade como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar.


Sobre a Vaga:


Com o apoio de uma equipe multidisciplinar, a nossa prática de Societário e M&A é especializada na assessoria a transações de M&A (domésticas e cross-border ) e investimentos, além das demandas consultivas em matéria societária a cliente nacionais e estrangeiros


O(a) Advogado(a) Sênior na equipe será responsável por:


  • Consultoria societária em operações de rotina e questões estratégicas dos clientes;
  • Elaboração e revisão de memorandos, pareceres e documentos em matéria societária;
  • Análise, elaboração e revisão de contratos e documentos societários, incluindo contratos e estatutos sociais, instrumentos de alteração de contrato social, atas de reunião e assembleia de sócios, instrumentos relacionados a operações societárias e livros societários;
  • Estruturação e execução de operações de M&A, Private Equity , Venture Capital e investimento estrangeiro, incluindo a elaboração, revisão e negociação de instrumento preliminares e definitivos utilizados nas operações;
  • Eventual suporte em litígios societários, em conjunto com a equipe de Contencioso;
  • Acompanhamento próximo de clientes, incluindo participação em reuniões estratégicas;
    e
  • Orientação e desenvolvimento de advogados juniores e plenos, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência do escritório.


Requisitos


  • Graduação em Direito com registro ativo na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB);
  • Pós-Graduação lato sensu em Direito Societário, Empresarial ou afins será considerado um diferencial;
  • Experiência sólida (mínimo de 5 ano) sem Direito Societário e M&A, com atuação comprovada em transações;
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Experiência em negociação com clientes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Coordenação de transações de M&A e projetos de baixa complexidade;
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia, tomar decisões estratégicas e liderar projetos multidisciplinares;
  • Experiência comgestão de equipe, demonstrando habilidades de liderança, capacidade de delegação e resolução de conflitos;
    e
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de articular conceitos complexos de forma clara e concisa.


Nossos desafios são para pessoas que:


  • Sabem que #JuntosSomosMaisFortes e que, em time, entregamos mais e melhor do que individualmente;
  • Aprendem e se adaptam todos os dias, sem perder sua essência;
  • Mantém a disciplina e a coragem para alcançar grandes resultados.


Queremos você em nosso time. Venha fazer parte!

title: Analista De Facilities
description:
POR QUE TRABALHAR CONOSCO

A Onze é uma fintech de previdência privada corporativa e saúde financeira. Nosso propósito é apoiar a construção do melhor futuro financeiro dos brasileiros. Somos a primeira PrevTech do Brasil, reinventamos a previdência com uma solução totalmente digital para um mercado tradicionalmente analógico. Acreditamos que a tecnologia e a inovação podem ter impacto real na maneira que as pessoas se preparam financeiramente para o futuro. Além de uma empresa de tecnologia, somos uma gestora de investimentos, com fundos de previdência privada eficientes e desenhados para trazer o melhor retorno com o menor custo possível – como a Previdência deve ser. Nossos fundos e soluções de saúde financeira tem como objetivo maximizar a acumulação eficiente de patrimônio, um dos maiores desafios do povo brasileiro.


SOBRE O TIME

Nosso time de Administração é uma equipe diversificada e colaborativa, composta por uma pessoa de Departamento Pessoal, duas pessoas do financeiro, uma em TI e uma diretora que coordena todas essas frentes. Juntos, trabalhamos para garantir a eficiência e o bom funcionamento de todos os processos internos, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inspirador.


SEU PAPEL:

Estamos em busca de um pessoa Analista de Facilities que seja dinâmica e proativa para se juntar à nossa equipe em crescimento. A profissional selecionada desempenhará um papel fundamental na garantia de que nosso ambiente de trabalho seja funcional, seguro e propício para o bem-estar de todos as pessoas colaboradoras.

  • Gerenciar as operações diárias das instalações do escritório, incluindo manutenção predial, equipe de limpeza, segurança e gestão de espaços.
  • Supervisionar e contatar quaisquer fornecedores de serviços, garantindo que os padrões de qualidade e eficiência sejam atendidos.
  • Organizar e coordenar toda a logística de eventos internos, incluindo reuniões, treinamentos, festas de confraternização e atividades de integração.
  • Estabelecer e manter contato com fornecedores, negociando contratos e garantindo a entrega de serviços de alta qualidade.
  • Participar ativamente de uma mudança de escritório, visitando espaços, coordenando a logística e garantindo uma transição completa e suave para o novo espaço.
  • Responsável por compras e controle de estoque de insumos e materiais escritórios;
  • Responsável poratender demandas de times/pessoas funcionárias como por ex.: compra de cesta de condolências, vouchers, passagens áreas, reservas de hotéis etc


O QUE PROCURAMOS:

  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas a facilities
  • Desejável: ter lista de fornecedores ativos
  • Habilidade para resolver problemas de forma eficaz e tomar decisões assertivas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa.
  • Senso de priorização e urgência para organização do dia a dia de demandas
  • Capacidade de se adaptar a um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico
  • Proatividade e iniciativa para identificar oportunidades de melhorias e implementar soluções e processos eficazes.
  • Organização e habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido de 3x na semana presencialmente na Vila Olímpia - com flexibilidade para ir 4x na semana quando necessário


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Acompanhamento e gestão de carreira com ciclos de avaliação semestrais estruturados e feedbacks recorrentes;
  • Planos de Saúdee Odontológico;
  • Plano de Saúde para Pet;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Benefício flexível para você escolher se quer gastar mais em refeição, mobilidade, cultura, home-office entre outros;
  • Incentivo educacional em formato de reembolso;
  • Voucher no mês de aniversário;
  • Gympass/TotalPass;
  • Empresa cidadã;
  • Plano de saúde financeira incluindo consultorias individualizadas com profissionais certificados;

title: Analista De Suporte Técnico
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Prestar serviços de sustentação aos nossos clientes, provendo soluções com empatia e pro atividade segundo nossa metodologia de processos. Garantir a satisfação dos clientes com os produtos e serviços TOTVS.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Realizar atividades de alta complexidade em quaisquer etapas da prestação do serviço de Suporte;
  • Conduzir tecnicamente os serviços de sustentação. Garantir a viabilidade técnica da solução e identificar os riscos durante a execução do serviço;
  • Conduzir tecnicamente os atendimentos em que atua, garantindo a viabilidade técnica da solução e identificando os riscos durante a execução do serviço;
  • Multiplicar o conhecimento técnico necessário para os demais Assistentes/Técnicos e Analistas da equipe em reuniões, treinamentos, capacitações e outros;
  • Analisar e identificar problemas (tickets, projeto, produto, processo, capacitação etc.) de maior complexidade e direcionar plano de ação para as áreas responsáveis e/ou para sua Coordenação;
  • Realizar o atendimento aos clientes por meio dos canais TOTVS, esclarecendo dúvidas sobre assuntos de alta complexidade referentes ao sistema. Registrar sugestões e incidentes;
  • Prestar o atendimento por meio de canais de abertura de tickets, de acordo com o processo definido procurando sanar questões e cumprir metas estabelecidas;
  • Registrar a solicitação do cliente no sistema, com todas as evidências (tickets abertos) de detalhamento necessárias para todos os impactados;
  • Posicionar a liderança sobre as solicitações ou incidentes que não forem evoluídos após o esgotamento das possibilidades de solução dentro do tempo estimado pela Coordenação da área;
  • Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros), quanto para o resultado e as metas da área;
  • Diagnosticar asnecessidades da área para identificar e sugerir melhorias e/ou inovações nos processos/metodologias;
  • Analisar as necessidades do cliente para identificar oportunidades e oferecer novos serviços da área;
  • Participar de comunidades, fóruns técnicos e canais de comunicação do segmento. Acompanhar as documentações e apoiar nos retornos e soluções para clientes internos e externos;
  • Contribuir de forma efetiva para a melhoria dos processos, sendo referência para o time;
  • Apontar diariamente as ordens de serviço nos projetos em que atuou;
  • Registrar todasas interações realizadas durante o atendimento das demandas em sistemas de chamado, e-mails, documentações específicas e demais canais utilizados no atendimento.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Formação: superior completo. Desejável especialização ou pós-graduação.

Conhecimentos específicos:

  • Conhecimento em ERP Protheus, módulos: Backoffice, Livros fiscais, Ativo fixo, Controladoria e contabilidade Ou OMS,WMS,TMS e GFE
  • Domínio das regras de negócio de acordo com a área de atuação;
  • Desejável conhecimento em ITIL;
  • Desejável conhecimento intermediário em linguagem de programação de acordo com o produto;
  • Conhecimento emTécnicas de Negociação e Apresentação;
  • Desejável conhecimento intermediário em lógica de programação, ADVPL e instruções de SQL.

Certificação: Desejável certificação nos módulos/produtos de atuação e em Metodologia ITIL, Scrum, Kanban etc.

Idioma: inglês e/ou espanhol intermediários - Diferencial


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e/ ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst
description:
Purpose of the Position

An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.


With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.


The main idea of this role is to protect the institution’s ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.

Concretely, the role:

  • Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.G., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees;
    drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil’s context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.G., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes;
    partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.

  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.G., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)


Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
